title: Adleman's experiment: from graph to molecules
approval: Author-agent design review, 2026-09-08; scientific acceptance remains pending.

figures.title: The historical graph, redrawn
figures.readerQuestion: Which directed edges define the instance?
figures.mechanism: Seven labeled vertices; fourteen directed edges; start 0 and target 6
figures.sequence: Read adjacency row by row; trace 0→1→2→3→4→5→6
figures.captionThesis: Direction, not page position, defines a route.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: A new layout must not change an arrow or imply a second witness.

figures.title: Four routes, four logical cases
figures.mechanism: Witness; legal short route; repeated-vertex walk; illegal-edge permutation
figures.sequence: Compare endpoints, adjacency, length and coverage independently
figures.evidenceSource: Original verification on the transcribed graph
figures.misleadingInterpretation: An all-vertex sequence can still use a forbidden edge.

figures.title: From a code to an oriented edge
figures.mechanism: Historical O2, O3, O4; left/right ten-base domains; O23 and O34
figures.sequence: Split codes; concatenate R2 L3 and R3 L4; compare with printed figure
figures.captionThesis: Edge fragments carry code halves; complementary vertex strands are splints.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Do not silently replace the historical encoding with vertex strands plus complementary edge bridges.

figures.title: Association is not a backbone bond
figures.readerQuestion: What changes between annealing and ligation?
figures.mechanism: Two edge fragments; antiparallel vertex splint; 3′ OH and 5′ phosphate nick
figures.sequence: Separated fragments; aligned duplex with nick; continuous ligated upper backbone
figures.evidenceSource: Adleman Fig. 2; Alberts DNA structure; NEB T4 ligase mechanism
figures.captionThesis: Pairing aligns ends; ligase seals the nick.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: A dashed base-pair contact must not look like a covalent connection.

figures.title: A tube is a multiset, not a search tree
figures.readerQuestion: What is parallel and what is sampled?
figures.mechanism: Digital route enumeration; physical candidate copies; absent witness
figures.sequence: Enumerate one route at a time; contrast simultaneous unequal molecular copies
figures.evidenceSource: Original multiset construction, not measured abundances
figures.captionThesis: Multiplicity and support are different resources.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Equal reagent amounts do not imply uniform routes.

figures.title: Endpoint amplification and information flow
figures.readerQuestion: Why do primer orientation and sites matter?
figures.mechanism: Double-stranded template; forward and reverse primers; products
figures.sequence: Denature; inward-facing annealing; 5′→3′ extension; selected-family enrichment
figures.evidenceSource: NHGRI PCR; historical primer identities from Adleman
figures.captionThesis: PCR amplifies a compatible family rather than deciding a Boolean predicate.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Off-target amplification and internal sites are possible.

figures.title: Length selects occurrences, not identities
figures.sequence: Separate by size; retain target fraction; compare same-size sequence orders
figures.evidenceSource: Adleman size selection; NHGRI electrophoresis; original length proof
figures.captionThesis: Length constrains vertex occurrences under the encoding convention.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Synthetic bands are not photographs or quantitative mobility predictions.

figures.title: Two bead operations, different retained material
figures.readerQuestion: Which phase is kept, and why?
figures.mechanism: Biotinylated strand; duplex; bead; free strand; sequence probe
figures.sequence: Immobilize biotin strand then denature/recover other strand; bind target to probe then wash/elute
figures.captionThesis: Preparing single strands and selecting a vertex are not the same separation.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Do not label biotin as the sequence-recognition element.

figures.title: Presence filtering consumes uncertainty and material
figures.readerQuestion: How does each vertex test change the pool?
figures.mechanism: Exact route rows; required vertices 1–5; survival counts
figures.sequence: Apply successive presence predicates and expose every count
figures.evidenceSource: Original bounded-walk program on historical graph
figures.captionThesis: The count ledger is computational output, not experimental yield.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Real retention is probabilistic and can lose the witness.

figures.title: One computation, three representations
figures.readerQuestion: How do algorithm, molecules and operations correspond?
figures.mechanism: Logical predicate; physical property; laboratory action; failure mode
figures.sequence: Read aligned rows from preparation through verification
figures.evidenceSource: Original synthesis of primary mechanism sources
figures.captionThesis: Each correspondence has assumptions and a failure boundary.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Avoid asserting one procedure is an exact molecular Boolean gate.

figures.title: A lane set is a projection of a population
figures.readerQuestion: Can these bands identify one molecule?
figures.mechanism: Historical witness/short/repeated routes; synthetic expected band sets
figures.sequence: Map occurrences to 20(j+1) bp; union bands across routes; compare mixtures
figures.evidenceSource: Adleman graduated-PCR explanation; original computed projection
figures.captionThesis: A lane records possible positions, not joint molecular identity.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: No photographic data or intensity claim.

figures.title: Soundness and survival pull in different directions
figures.readerQuestion: What can purification destroy or retain?
figures.mechanism: True witness copies; false candidates; conditional retention; no-signal event
figures.sequence: Propagate expected counts; compute zero-survivor probability under stated independence
figures.evidenceSource: Original probability model; historical error discussion as motivation
figures.captionThesis: A cleaner surviving pool may come with more false negatives.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Expectations are not measured copy counts or guaranteed recovery.

figures.title: Count materials before celebrating parallelism
figures.readerQuestion: Which budget grows, and under what assumption?
figures.mechanism: Historical reagent amount; copies; species; volume; fixed-endpoint permutation space
figures.sequence: Convert units; separate initial oligos from complete routes; expose sampling assumptions
figures.evidenceSource: Adleman note 4; BIPM mole; original arithmetic
figures.captionThesis: Reagent inventory, path support and search-space size are distinct.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: No universal factorial lower bound for DNA computation.

figures.title: Several mechanisms grew beyond generate-and-filter
figures.readerQuestion: What changes in the next research traditions?
figures.mechanism: SAT filtering; formal systems; automata; assembly; strand displacement
figures.sequence: Compare state, operation and readout across categories without a causal genealogy
figures.evidenceSource: Lipton; Boneh et al.; Benenson; Winfree et al.; Seelig et al.
figures.captionThesis: The field branches by mechanism, not a universal superiority ranking.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: A conceptual map is not proof that one paper caused every branch.
